title: Lead with outcome guarantee, not mechanism
context: Product messaging previously emphasized the mechanism first ('engineering-memory and architectural-conformance layer'). Testing/validation indicated customers respond better to the outcome first: the guarantee that agents never remake decided decisions or reintroduce fixed bugs.
decision: Repositioned README and homepage hero to lead with the guarantee statement as the primary value prop. Technical mechanisms (graph, interview, enforcement) moved to supporting evidence role ('how'). Applied this consistently across all five supported languages using native translations, with all changes flowing through generation tooling—no hand-edited generated files.
consequences: Users encounter the outcome guarantee before technical architecture details
Clearer, more direct expectation-setting about what problems Hunch prevents
Stronger coherence across marketing surfaces in multiple languages with tooling-enforced translation integrity
v1.17.0 release branded under this new positioning
Messaging now leads with Hunch's actual differentiation (preventing regressions) rather than its mechanism (memory tracking)
alternatives_rejected: Use transliterated copy instead of native translations
Hand-edit generated locale files to keep messaging in sync
Keep stale version references in eyebrow text
